name: CETC Lantian Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CETC Lantian Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sales, and service of electrical energy materials, products, and systems. The company offers physical power supplies, chemical power supplies, power supply systems, and other upstream and downstream products in the power supply chain. The company also offers products including solar arrays, lithium-ion batteries, power controllers for vehicles, commercial spaceflight, and controllers. In addition, the company offers physicochemical analysis, individual unit testing, module testing, individual unit testing, special environment testing, component testing, and power plant testing for physical power supplies; …
